title: Geometric boundary model before bidual transposition
statement: For an index type I, boundary-arrow types B(Z,T), symmetric monoidal closed categories P(T), monoidal categories E(T), and the operations o of [def-weil-boundary-duality-input], define a normalized geometric model on object predicates ctf(T) as follows. The native dual D_T=[-,omega_T] preserves it; ordinary restriction s preserves it; and the native evaluation double-dual delta is invertible on it. The specified symmetry is the native braiding, and specified evaluation is braiding followed by the internal-Hom counit. There is a dualizing isomorphism theta:G omega_T -> omega_Z normalized by C_Z G(unit) followed by theta = C_Z(ecomp). There is a tensor map tau:sM tensor GN -> G(M tensor N) for every ctf M and arbitrary N, normalized by s(counit_M) tensor identity followed by tau = tensorModel. On ctf M,N it is natural in both variables. Write q=tau, define r, alpha, c, b by the formulas in [lem-weil-boundary-bidual-transpose], using the specified theta. Alpha is invertible on ctf inputs. The opposite-currying identity is not part of this definition; it follows formally from q naturality and native evaluation. No beta is introduced and no beta invertibility or beta double-dual compatibility is part of this definition.
